children: News Corp disclosed it has repurchased approximately $480.94 million of shares to date under its authorized $1 billion 2025 repurchase program.
Daily ASX filings cover buy-backs of Nasdaq-listed Class A and Class B shares under the 2025 Repurchase Program.
The company has purchased about $480,943,751 of Class A and Class B shares to date under the $1B authorization.
On 16 Sep 2026 the company bought 12,012,660 shares for US$313,155,641.88 across classes reported.
On 16 Sep 2026 separate class entries show additional purchases: 5,597,499 shares for US$165,330,697.29 and smaller lots.
Repurchases are intended to enhance shareholder value and are subject to market conditions and securities laws.
